reviews.comment: Great for 415 and 416. Organized and always gets grades back within a week. Her explanations are clear and she's always willing to reexplain something if you don't understand. Grading is fair. Don't expect to get away without studying though, as this is still a 400 level honors math class.

415 (along with 409) are considered to be "rights of passage" for math majors. Dr. Witherspoon made the topic of algebra very easy and intuitive. One homework assignment a week which is somewhat challenging. Three tests which test a very fundamental understanding of the material (so if you know your stuff, they are very easy). Many office hours.
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Class has 4 tests, no quizzes. Prof gives out old tests from past semesters to help you study. 1 homework/week. You have to write a paper in Math 220 no matter which prof you take but Dr. Witherspoon lets you write about any math topic that interests you. This math is different from most, so it'll take some getting used to, but it's not very hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Witherspoon is a good professor and a good lecturer. If you pay attention you will learn. That being said, if you zone out for a minute then you will probably be confused. She is a fair grader, tests are pretty average and her expectations are clear.

Dr. Witherspoon is a very smart and sweet woman. However, her lectures tended to be confusing and overly complicated. She would stop in the middle of problems to work another, and would work out some problems wrong, which rendered my notes useless. I relied very heavily on the textbook to learn everything. However, she is an easy grader.
She makes herself accessible and theres only about an hour or two of homework every week.  The textbook wouldve been useful for studying for tests, but I didnt use it and got along alright.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Gives good feedback--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Her lectures were slightly scattered but I learned a lot as far as proofs and where things come from. Not sure why people below said there was a lot of HW-it was actually a manageable amount due once/week. The HW and recit quizzes are much harder than the exams (pretty easy btw), and she gives lots of partial credit. Overall, sweet and considerate.

I took her honors section of Math 172 and honestly, I was bored in the class. But she is a good teacher and I learned a lot, she just didn't make lectures interesting. Also, some of her lectures were all over the place. But tests weren't too terribly difficult and she gave us a bonus question, which was nice.

I took her as honors so may be different. Very kind and helpful during office hours but very scatterbrained during lecture. Tests were not super difficult and had a bonus question. If you have something come up, she's usually super considerate & helpful. Recommend, but only if you are okay with being bored and doing lots of homework.

She's super nice, but a little aloof. I would seek outside help if you need any. But otherwise, pretty chill teacher with relatively do-able tests. Our TA was awesome:) And recitation quizzes were super easy - if they were ever harder, you could just ask the TA or fellow students - basically a group quiz.

Very hard to follow in lectures. Many other classmates including myself had to seek extra help understanding the materials. Her lectures are very hard to get through and the way she words things and explains is very hard to understand and is very different from other math instructors. I have heard the other professors are better for this course.
If there was ever a teacher that could teach kindergartners abstract algebra, it would be her.
Doctor Witherspoon was a great professor! I would definitely recommend her to all looking to take MATH 171. She really takes time to explain theories well and answers all questions thoroughly.

Felt just like a highschool class, and was pretty easy having taken calc in highschool.  She teaches everything you need to know during class, and the tests aren't bad. Calculators allowed, recitation quizzes are basically group quizzes. Overall a super chill class.
